figurative_meaning_en: Standing face to face or on equal terms
example_sentences_in_bangla: তারা সোজা দাঁড়িয়ে তর্ক করতে লাগল।
বন্ধুরা সোজা দাঁড়ানো অবস্থায় গল্প করছিল।
example_sentences_in_english: They stood face to face and argued fiercely.
The friends were standing toe to toe, discussing the issue directly.
note: This idiom emphasizes straightforward and equal interaction in Bengali conversational culture.
